name: USER-PUBLIC-G3
status: candidate; HTTP contract tests only; consumer review pending

routes.request: nickName,avatar,sex; target user is authenticated subject

routes.data: roles, permissions, user; roles and menus must be active

envelope: code/msg/data; data omitted for null; Java Long IDs serialized as strings

errors.403: valid identity but insufficient scope/admin qualification
errors.503: DB or Redis state cannot be determined; body code 500

revocation: PENDING intent commits before Redis delete; local fact becomes REVOKED after successful delete. No delivery or Agent pause claimed.
security: register and profile ignore non-whitelisted fields; current account and session validated on each protected request
limits: no gateway integration, real MySQL/Redis validation, RBAC CRUD, Stream delivery, or legacy path aliases in this slice
